title: A record-at-a-time loop that should be one query
prompt: BALRPT.sqlrpgle walks CUSTMAST with SETLL and READE and adds up the balances of one branch, one record at a time. Replace the native I/O with embedded SQL: a cursor over the rows that matter, fetched in a loop, with SQLCODE checked after every statement and the cursor closed on every path. Keep the same total.
check: ! codeonly BALRPT.sqlrpgle | grep -qiE '\b(setll|reade|chain|read) +' && codeonly BALRPT.sqlrpgle | grep -qiE 'declare +[a-z0-9_]+ +cursor' && codeonly BALRPT.sqlrpgle | grep -qiE 'exec +sql +(open|fetch)' && codeonly BALRPT.sqlrpgle | grep -qiE 'exec +sql +close' && [ $(codeonly BALRPT.sqlrpgle | grep -ciE 'sqlcode|sqlstt') -ge 2 ] && codeonly BALRPT.sqlrpgle | grep -qi 'branch'
